sources.citation: Proclamation 11002, clause 3; Annex, U.S. note 39(a)-(d), notes 2(v)(xvi), 2(x)(xv), 2(z)(xiii) (91 FR 2443, 2449-2455).

contains_logic_integrated_circuit.label: Article is or contains a logic integrated circuit

all_logic_ic_specs_reviewed.label: All logic ICs were reviewed for note 39(b)
all_logic_ic_specs_reviewed.description: Confirm review of all ICs. If any qualifies, supply that same IC’s TPP and DRAM bandwidth below; otherwise supply the reviewed non-qualifying specifications. A single non-qualifying IC cannot establish exclusion for a multi-IC article.

total_processing_performance.label: Logic IC total processing performance (TPP)
total_processing_performance.description: Note 39(b): aggregate 2 × peak MacTOPS × bit length over processing units on the IC; highest supported TPP, dense matrices without sparsity. Do not substitute marketing TOPS or add TPP across different ICs. A qualifying IC establishes inclusion; exclusion requires reviewing every logic IC in the article.

dram_bandwidth_gb_s.label: Same IC total local DRAM bandwidth (GB/s)
dram_bandwidth_gb_s.description: Aggregate IC-to-DRAM bandwidth including co-packaged and non-co-packaged DRAM; exclude DRAM accessed remotely over an interconnect.

semiconductor_end_use.label: Confirmed U.S. end-use eligibility
semiconductor_end_use.description: Declare none unless the shipment meets note 39(d). R&D must meet its systematic study/development definition; startup means emerging growth company under 15 USC 77b(a)(19). Consumer and civil industrial uses exclude data-center applications. All listed uses must be in the United States. Other Secretary-approved uses need separate source review.

data_center_new_ai_load_mw.label: U.S. data-center new load dedicated to AI (MW)
data_center_new_ai_load_mw.description: New load dedicated to AI inference, training, simulation or synthetic data generation. Greater than 100 MW is required; existing/general facility load is not the statutory measure.
